role: Full visible Chat foundation, provider/model/settings/tool surfaces, current live route.
current_route_note: As of 2026-06-25 current RootView mounts AgentCloneChatHostSurface for Chat/Act. That Epistemos-owned shell adds session/context rails, takes a bounded AgentCloneAppContextSnapshot with deterministic model-visible summary/JSON that omits the internal app-support path, and embeds AgentClone.ContentView() as the protected Swift-agent foundation, with Epistemos theme-token injection, AgentCloneBridge prompt delivery, and bounded AgentCloneHostContext workspace/vault/mode/surface grounding. AgentPortalContextSnapshot is now the Epistemos-owned portal spine: Landing seeds it for live submissions, AgentChatState stores it on the active session, user messages receive bounded ContextAttachment handles, and RootView/AgentCloneBridge publish its bridgePresentation so the clone sees the portal/session/action context without reviving old ChatState routes. Mini, Note, Graph, and Vault are represented as typed future portal kinds, not restored private engines. Landing submissions select .act, preserve the app-level AgentChatState session record, seed AgentClone with the app-owned support path, keep the raw user prompt in AgentChatState, and send AgentCloneBridge.submitPrompt(portalContext.agentClonePromptEnvelope(...)) so the clone runtime receives bounded portal/session/vault/note/graph/action context. The envelope and visible host/compact portal action chips use Epistemos-owned action descriptors for app-context snapshot, vault search, note create/update/delete/rewrite, graph read/mutate, session summary, and skill discovery, with approval and mutation metadata. Bridge-submitted prompts enter AgentClone's normal run()/runTabTask(tab:) paths. RootView still publishes appSupportRootPath for Application Support/Epistemos/AgentClone so AgentClone SessionStore uses app-owned transcript storage while preserving legacy import/read/delete fallback. Bundled help HTML is an adapted foreground surface that says Epistemos/Epistemos Scripts/privileged helper while preserving exact compatibility paths and helper ids only as technical facts. The deleted ActOsaurusPromptRequest/Osaurus notification bridge and old Epistemos local-chat backend must not return.
